usage: study.py [-h] --job-id JOB_ID --authorization AUTHORIZATION --output
                OUTPUT

Internal v0.9 Plan B trainer. Full fits only after a root hash-bound release.
No test loader, no outcome-dependent stopping, no in-place resume. Interrupted
attempts remain evidence; reviewed same-recipe recovery uses a fresh
directory.

Root-gated command line for Q-Path Multiplier (ETEL); no implicit approval.

positional arguments:
  {run,status,drain,resume,cancel,recover}

    resume              Clear drain after root usage review; does not launch
